construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation created for this isolated build

input.products: Required array, 0..10000 products. Each requires unique trimmed id, title, category (nonblank strings <=500 characters) and finite nonnegative price. Optional tags array defaults [], popularity number in [0,1] defaults 0, in_stock boolean defaults true.
input.customer: Optional object defaults {}. preferred_categories, preferred_tags, excluded_categories, viewed_product_ids, purchased_product_ids are optional string arrays defaulting []. History ids must reference catalog ids. max_price, when supplied, is a finite nonnegative number.
input.validation: Unknown object fields, duplicate JSON keys, nonfinite numbers, malformed JSON and invalid field types rejected. String arrays limited to 1000 entries and deduplicated. Category/tag matching trims and casefolds; ids trim but remain case-sensitive. Explicit null is not equivalent to omission. Prices share one caller-defined currency.

output.filtered: Exclusive first-match counts in order: out_of_stock, already_purchased, excluded_category, over_budget

shared_schema.validation_layer: validate(payload) is used by recommend(payload), which is also the only CLI recommendation entry point. API validation raises ValidationError; CLI translates errors to JSON.

cross_stage_handoffs: Single stage: validated catalog/customer -> eligibility filters -> deterministic scoring -> ordered recommendations in shared output schema.

behavior.fixture_data: All products and customer preferences in the example and tests are clearly labeled synthetic.
behavior.scoring: Start with popularity. Add 5 for preferred category and 2 per distinct preferred tag. Union viewed history contributes 1 for category affinity and 0.5 per matching tag. Union purchased history contributes 2 for category affinity and 1 per matching tag. History duplicates do not amplify scores.
behavior.ranking: Descending raw score, descending popularity, ascending price, then ascending case-sensitive product id. Display scores rounded to six decimals. No input mutation, time dependence, randomness or persistent state.
behavior.fallback: No preference or history signals yields cold_start popularity ranking. Candidates without matching signals receive popularity_fallback reason even in personalized mode. Empty eligible catalogs return successful empty arrays.
behavior.history_policy: Purchased products excluded; viewed products remain eligible. History-derived affinities can originate from otherwise filtered products.
behavior.explanations: Each result lists the matching scoring factors, or popularity_fallback. Mode indicates profile signal presence, not guaranteed relevance.
behavior.llm: None; all logic is deterministic and local.

included: Synthetic unit and subprocess CLI fixtures

coverage: Invalid numeric values and field types
Duplicate JSON keys and nonfinite JSON
